{{Quote|Yes. I remember... my father and I, walking Axial Park. He said, "Syo, we were... once...."|Syo Bakarn|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''father''' of [[Syo Bakarn]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Bakarn family]]. His son Syo joined the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] at an early age, though Syo remembered walking in [[Axial Park]] with his father.
